project_scope.note: The source pool preserves older Matelea usage. Current learner organization keeps only M. edwardsensis and M. reticulata in Matelea; former M. biflora is canonical Chthamalia biflora, and legacy M. gonocarpos maps to an unresolved Gonolobus suberosus var. granulatus concept.

priority: reticulate versus longitudinal or uniform corolla markings
growth form: low hairy herb versus vigorous twiner
study_strategy.warning: Do not treat every historical 'Matelea' record as the same modern genus concept. In this local set, M. biflora is Chthamalia biflora and legacy M. gonocarpos points to a Gonolobus concept that remains range/taxon-concept HOLD.

quick_key.if: flat broad pale-green flower with strong dark net-reticulation and a silvery center on a hairy twining vine
more bell-shaped pale-green flower with mainly longitudinal lines, hairy inner corolla, and obvious fleshy corona segments
low densely hairy plant with paired dark maroon-brown star flowers
quick_key.then: Chthamalia biflora — source name Matelea biflora

quick_key.if: large cordate leaves, relatively large uniform olive-green flowers, smooth sharply angled follicle
quick_key.then: Gonolobus suberosus var. granulatus — legacy Matelea gonocarpos concept; reviewed unresolved HOLD

quick_key.if: tiny desert twiner with very small leaves and tiny brown/maroon-to-green flowers

source_concept_status.note: B005 user-accepted unresolved hold; Travis and Williamson firm for Gonolobus suberosus var. granulatus, legacy Hays/Kerr records not counted until concept reconciliation.
